  •  NON - AGENDA ITEM  - at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while

The listing of any item on the agenda includes the authority of the Commission to take

  A.  REQUEST FROM TEMPLE CITY AMERICAN LITTLE LEAGUE (TCALL)
  FOR RESERVED USE OF LIVE OAK PARK BASEBALL FIELD AND
  HANGING BANNERS

  As required by the Agreement for use of the Athletic Fields, the
  Commission is requested to review and approve the request for
  reserved use of the baseball field at Live Oak Park for the 202  7 spring
  season and post season and hanging of sponsor and registration
  banners.

  Presentation:  Adam Matsumoto, Director of Parks & Recreation

  Recommendation:  Approve the request from TCALL for reserved use
  of the baseball field at Live Oak Park from January
  – July 202 7 for their spring season, hanging of
  sponsor and registration banners and waive the
  51% residency requirement for reserved use of the
  field.
